scientific_integrity: The proof is a universal two-inequality Bezout argument combined with exact line incidences and an intersection-square computation; a standalone exact incidence checker is supplemental. Historical priority remains qualified by unindexed work. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the fixed twenty-one marked points over C with two positive real orbit weights; it does not classify all minimizers at the wall, establish semiampleness of the nef isotropic class, or treat other configurations or positive characteristic.
title: The two-weight Seshadri wall of the twelve-line Hesse arrangement
